pit_row_contract.revision_rule: never overwrite a prior PIT vintage; later revisions are new observations and cannot be backdated

nodes.applicability: conditional on business model having material physical/service capacity or supply discipline

nodes.applicability: conditional on economically meaningful inventory or channel stock
nodes.notes: inventory and revenue may be combined only with compatible units/periods and explicit transform identity

nodes.applicability: general where demand/order evidence is economically meaningful
nodes.notes: revenue is realized demand/capture evidence and is not a complete orders/backlog substitute

nodes.applicability: general where price or mix is an economically meaningful margin driver
nodes.notes: no market-price substitution; missing company/industry pricing evidence remains UNOBSERVED

nodes.applicability: conditional on utilization or throughput having economic meaning
nodes.notes: margin cannot be relabeled as utilization; direct utilization/cost evidence is preferred and absence remains UNOBSERVED

nodes.role: downstream operating leverage and cash conversion
nodes.applicability: general where reported margins/cash flow are meaningful
nodes.notes: structured fields keep source units and PIT vintage; sign/inflection transforms are versioned

nodes.notes: observed consensus and management guidance remain distinct epistemic classes
